sentences.en: The road of excess leads to the palace of wisdom.
sentences.zh: 过剩的道路通向智慧的宫殿。

sentences.en: You get more wisdom as you have more experiences.
sentences.zh: 经历得越多，得到的智慧也就越多。

sentences.en: We admired his wisdom, not to mention his courage.
sentences.zh: 我们钦佩他的智慧，更不用说他的勇气了。

senses.zh: 智慧，明智,常识，好的判断力,知识，学问,古训
